delete_repo_files: delete files matching glob patterns from a Hugging Face Hub repository via CLI
delete_single_file: delete a single file from a Hugging Face Hub repository by specifying its path
delete_folder: delete an entire folder from a Hugging Face Hub repository by appending a trailing slash
delete_multiple_patterns: delete multiple files and folders using glob patterns in a single CLI command
delete_revision_pr: delete files from a specific revision or pull request on a Hugging Face Hub repository
